title: lycianthes dejecta
intro: Lycianthes dejecta, commonly known as the "Hawaiian blueberry," is a type of flowering shrub native to Hawaii. It is known for its edible purple berries and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The plant has been found to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Lycianthes dejecta include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
